mentions.name: NotifyButton
mentions.description: A frontend script plus backend SaaS platform for DSA (Digital Services Act) compliance. Once integrated into a site, it lets users report legal content issues directly to the operator, who then manages those reports through a dedicated dashboard following official EU procedures, reducing the likelihood of complaints going through state or EU channels that can trigger investigations.
mentions.problem: Without such a system, users are much more likely to file complaints through official state or EU channels, which can trigger investigations and expose EU-operating sites to heavy fines.
mentions.audience: EU-based website operators who want to avoid heavy DSA fines
mentions.source_excerpt:
NotifyButton - A simple script on the frontend of your site, a complete SaaS platform on the backend for DSA compliance.

If you operate in the EU and want to avoid heavy fines, this is for you. Once integrated, it allows users to report legal content issues directly to you, which you can then manage via a dedicated dashboard following official EU procedures.
